concerns.text: AC-006 requires `timestamp_regularity` to be calculated per user, but the chosen HuggingFace dataset `cardiffnlp/tweet_sentiment_extraction` does not contain `timestamp` or `user_id` fields. Without these fields the proxy cannot be computed, violating the acceptance criteria and SC-002 (Data Independence).

The specification does not model or control for obvious confounding variables (e.g., user‑level random effects, time‑of‑day posting patterns, platform‑specific posting habits). These factors can induce spurious correlations between metadata‑based control proxies and text‑derived anxiety scores, undermining the validity of the correlation analysis (SC‑008/SC‑009). A proper design should include covariate adjustment or a mixed‑effects model.
